Clear Aligners

A 1-minute patient guide with narration. Press space to pause.

Patient guide

Clear aligners.

A nearly invisible way to straighten your smile.

Straighter teeth.

Aligners can fix crowding, gaps, and many bite problems.

Your digital plan.

A digital scan maps your teeth, and we plan every movement.

Custom clear trays.

A series of trays, each one moving your teeth a little at a time.

Wear them all day.

20 to 22 hours a day. Take them out to eat, and to drink anything but water.

Step by step.

Every week or two, you switch to the next set of trays.

Your new smile.

Treatment time varies. Many cases take about a year, and simpler ones can be faster.

Keep it straight.

A retainer holds your teeth in their new position.

Brush before trays go back inClean trays dailyWear your retainer

Questions? Just ask.

Your dental team is happy to walk you through every step.
